info.name: StockData Entities News API
info.description: StockData.org provides free real-time, intraday, and historical stock, forex, and cryptocurrency market data along with global financial news and sentiment analysis. The API delivers market data for US-listed stocks including OHLCV data, splits, dividends, and entity-level news sentiment from 5,000+ sources in 30+ languages. All endpoints require an api_token parameter.
